title: Marino's Railway Resource Pack
description: An addition to mods such as Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR) to decorate your train stations
body:
**Marino's Railway Resource Pack** is a custom resource pack designed for use with the [Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR)](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-transit-railway) mod. It adds a set of hand-crafted signs and textures inspired by the **London Underground**, giving your railway builds a more authentic and polished look.

# What's included?
## Custom Signs
- **North/South Platform Signs** — Directional platform signage styled after London Underground wayfinding
- **Central Line Signs** — Two small-format signs inspired by the real Central Line, perfect for line indicators and platform boards

## Custom Block Textures
- **Ticket Machine** — A reskinned ticket machine texture inspired by the iconic Oyster card machines found across the London Underground
- **Prohibition Signs** — Custom "No Rubbish" and "No Spitting" sign textures to add authentic station atmosphere

# Requirements
- [Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR)](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-transit-railway) mod
